Class Shot

java.lang.Object
enemy.ability.Shot
public class Shot extends Object
A ball fired by the Shoot ability: it flies straight, slows down and dies out, or stops on the first wall, closed door or enemy. The stronger the shot, the faster and the further it goes. It hits the targets it flies over.

    • update

      public void update(double dt, Arena arena, List<? extends Target> targets)
      Moves the ball by one frame, in steps of half its radius so it can't jump over a thin wall. The air slows it down; it stops when it leaves the world, touches an obstacle or an enemy, or gets too slow, and hits the targets on its way.
      Parameters:
      dt - time since the last frame, in s
      arena - the world the ball flies in
      targets - what the ball can hit
